subject.title: fix(zai): send user agent during endpoint detection

question: Should this PR wait for live Z.AI Coding Plan endpoint-detection proof, or can maintainers accept the credential gap for this narrow header fix?
rationale: The contributor disclosed that they do not have a Z.AI Coding Plan key, and ClawSweeper's external-PR proof gate cannot be cleared by tests alone without maintainer-supplied proof or an explicit override.

options.title: Require Redacted Live Smoke
options.body: Use a redacted Z.AI Coding Plan key to show endpoint detection selecting the coding endpoint after this patch before merge.

options.title: Accept Credential Gap
options.body: Apply a maintainer proof override because the code change is narrow, source-backed, and covered by a focused header regression test.

options.title: Pick A Sibling Candidate
options.body: Select another open sibling PR as the canonical landing path only if it has stronger proof and an equally narrow diff.

recommendation.title: Require Redacted Live Smoke
recommendation.body: Use a redacted Z.AI Coding Plan key to show endpoint detection selecting the coding endpoint after this patch before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the original endpoint-detection and Coding Plan support history for this provider surface.
